Tamil Nadu Assembly Sees Opposition Walkout Amidst Political Exchanges

The Tamil Nadu Assembly experienced disruptions and walkouts from opposition parties, primarily the DMK, during a debate. Key issues raised included allegations of corruption and criticism over the design of a birthday cake for Chief Minister Joseph Vijay. The exchanges also involved political barbs between the Chief Minister and opposition members.
